questions.solution_text:
$\frac{(b-2)^{2}}{12}=27$
$(b-2)^{2}=324$
$b-2=18$ or $b-2=-18$
$b=20$ or $b=-16$
$b=-16$ is rejected because $b$ must be greater than $a=2$.
$b=20$
